muc_tieu: Model re viet test cho 6 module chua co test; may CHAY test tren ma that: dat = test hop le, hong = test sai hoac ma co loi (Claude phan loai)
boi_canh: Du an The Brain, Python 3.11, numpy/pandas co san.

tasks.prompt:
Viet bai TEST cho module 'dich_tham_so' (xem tep). Quy tac:
- Chi dung thu vien chuan + `from nhan import ...`. Moi test la ham `def test_...():` khong tham so, dung `assert`. KHONG ghi tep, KHONG goi mang, KHONG dung pytest/unittest.
- Moi test kiem MOT hanh vi co that cua module bang du lieu NHO tu dung ngay trong test (khong doc tep ngoai). Co it nhat 3 ca bien (dau vao xau / rong / bien gioi).
- Chi khang dinh nhung gi ban THAY trong ma (doc ky tham so va gia tri tra ve); khong doan hanh vi. Neu khong chac thi bo ca do.
- 6 den 12 ham test. Tra DUNG mot khoi ```python ... ``` va khong gi them.
- Moi ten (bien, ham, lop) dung trong test PHAI co that trong tep hoac duoc import ro rang; khong dung ten chua dinh nghia.
